classes.SOURCE_REASONING: Reading or deriving from supplied source; no execution claim.
classes.MODULE_MODEL: Execution of an explicitly bounded dependency-free model; no genuine ORM/native qualification.
classes.SYNTHETIC_PRACTICE: Constructed educational claim or witness, never attributed to a real student or Gemini interaction.
classes.GENUINE_ORM_SQLITE: Actual supplied application operation with loaded native driver, owned fixture, runtime and raw evidence; not granted by source identity.
classes.LOCAL_HTTP: Actual request/response to the recorded owned loopback instance; not granted by a DOM, response model or file:// page.
classes.ACTUAL_GEMINI: Actual bounded sanitised interaction, independently checked; structural validators cannot authenticate service origin.
classes.NATIVE_BROWSER: Observed native browser behaviour with version and scope; static parse is insufficient.
classes.NATIVE_WINDOWS: Observed native Windows operation with scope; path model is insufficient.
classes.NATIVE_MACOS: Observed native macOS operation with scope; Linux cannot qualify it.
classes.NATIVE_WORD: Observed Word render/edit/export with scope; LibreOffice or XML parse cannot qualify it.
classes.NOT_EXECUTED: Explicitly pending, blocked or unavailable required operation.
